verdict.reasoning: Patient reports hearing problems and facial numbness on the left for a few weeks: "having some problems with my hearing... face has been feeling a bit numb" and "Just one side. Just on my left side"; duration: "It's been a few weeks now. About three weeks or something."
Decreased hearing is localized to the left ear: "Just one side. Just on my left side. I've noticed that the hearing's kind of gone down a bit."
Numbness location: "again, it's the left side. It's kind of like around my left ear and kind of along here. So like my jawline sort of feeling a bit numb around here."

Patient mentions ringing in the ear intermittently: clinician prompts "Some ringing in your ear" and later patient says "just like I said, like the ringing occasionally" indicating intermittent tinnitus.
Patient links dizziness to the ringing: "especially sometimes when I get a ringing, I feel a bit dizzy."

Transcript details left unilateral hearing loss, ipsilateral facial numbness, intermittent ringing and dizziness for about three weeks: combined from "Just on my left side... hearing's kind of gone down", numbness description on left, "ringing occasionally" and "sometimes when I get a ringing, I feel a bit dizzy", and duration "a few weeks now. About three weeks or something."

Remote, uncertain history of labyrinthitis: "I think they said ages ago I had something called can't quite remember, but labyrinthitis, something like that. But again, nothing. Nothing on."

Clinician considers Bell’s palsy: "What you're describing might be something called Bell's palsy."
Clinician requests in-person neurological and ear exam: "I would like you to be assessed in a clinic today... so that we can do what we call a neurological examination... have a look inside the ear."

Same-day face-to-face clinic visit in central London is supported, but specific mention of "neurological examination including cranial nerves and otoscopy" is not explicitly stated; transcript only says "neurological examination" and "have a look inside the ear" without naming cranial nerves or otoscopy.

Admin booking and support number in notes: "I'm going to send a message to our admin team. I'll ask them to book you in... And then you can ring the support team number. I'll leave that number in your notes."
Timing for call: "you can ring the support team number... You can ring them after five minutes and then they'll slot you into a place that's convenient for you."
